verdict.rationale: Lium publishes a live OpenAPI 3.1 schema and markdown docs with CLI snippets. Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive API reference, such as a try-it console or explorer, where examples can be run in place. A machine-readable schema is a building block for such a reference, not the reference itself. The probe 404s were at docs.lium.io paths, not the documented lium.io/api/openapi.json, so they neither confirm nor refute the schema.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
